DOBOT 6Axis ROS2 V4

**Dobot Robotics ROS2 Software Development Kit** High-performance robot control framework based on TCP/IP protocol [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_ZH.md) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Ubuntu%2024.04-blue?style=flat-square)](https://ubuntu.com/download/server) [![ROS](https://img.shields.io/badge/ROS2-Jazzy-green?style=flat-square)](https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
--- ## Quick Start ### System Requirements | Requirement | Version | |-------------|---------| | OS | Ubuntu 24.04 LTS | | ROS Version | ROS2 Jazzy | | Python | 3.10+ | | Simulation | Gazebo Sim (Harmonic) | ### Network Configuration | Configuration | Description | |---------------|-------------| | Robot IP | 192.168.5.1 (must be in the same subnet) | | Control Port | 29999 | | Feedback Port | 30004 | ### Installation ```bash # Create workspace mkdir -p ~/dobot_ws/src cd ~/dobot_ws/src git clone -b jazzy https://github.com/Dobot-Arm/DOBOT_6Axis_ROS2_V4.git cd ~/dobot_ws # Install dependencies sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y \ ros-jazzy-moveit \ ros-jazzy-ros-gz-sim \ ros-jazzy-ros-gz-bridge \ ros-jazzy-gz-ros2-control \ ros-jazzy-joint-state-publisher \ ros-jazzy-robot-state-publisher # Build colcon build --symlink-install source install/local_setup.sh ``` > For a step-by-step installation guide, see [docs/INSTALL_JAZZY_EN.md](docs/INSTALL_JAZZY_EN.md). --- ## Robot Model Switching & IP Configuration ### Switching Robot Models The project uses the `DOBOT_TYPE` environment variable to select between different robot models. Supported values: | DOBOT_TYPE | Robot Model | | ----------- | ----------- | | `cr3` | CR3 | | `cr5` | CR5 (default) | | `cr7` | CR7 | | `cr10` | CR10 | | `cr10af` | CR10AF | | `cr12` | CR12 | | `cr16` | CR16 | | `cr20` | CR20 | | `cr30h` | CR30H | | `me6` | E6 / ME6 | | `nova2` | Nova2 | | `nova5` | Nova5 | Set the environment variable in your terminal (example for CR5): ```bash export DOBOT_TYPE=cr5 ``` To make it permanent, add the line above to your `~/.bashrc` file. ### Configuring Robot IP Address The project uses the `IP_address` environment variable to pass the actual robot IP address: ```bash export IP_address=192.168.5.1 ``` > The default robot IP is `192.168.5.1`. Modify it according to your actual network setup. Make sure your computer is on the same subnet as the robot. ## Quick Launch (5 Scenarios) Select the scenario you need. Set `DOBOT_TYPE` before any command: ```bash export DOBOT_TYPE=cr5 ``` | # | Scenario | Command | |---|----------|---------| | 1 | RViz visualization (robot model only) | `ros2 launch dobot_rviz dobot_rviz.launch.py` | | 2 | MoveIt virtual simulation (no Gazebo, no hardware) | `ros2 launch dobot_moveit moveit_demo.launch.py` | | 3 | Gazebo simulation only (no MoveIt) | `ros2 launch dobot_gazebo dobot_gazebo.launch.py` | | 4 | **Gazebo + MoveIt** joint simulation | `ros2 launch dobot_gazebo sim.launch.py` | | 5 | **MoveIt + real robot** (hardware required) | see below | > **Scenario 4 (Gazebo + MoveIt):** `sim.launch.py` starts Gazebo, MoveGroup and RViz together in one command. > Alternatively, launch them separately in two terminals: > ```bash > # Terminal 1 > ros2 launch dobot_gazebo dobot_gazebo.launch.py > # Terminal 2 > ros2 launch dobot_moveit moveit_gazebo.launch.py > ``` ### Scenario 5: MoveIt + Real Robot ```bash # 1. Set robot model and IP export DOBOT_TYPE=cr5 export IP_address=192.168.5.1 # 2. Launch robot driver (Terminal 1) ros2 launch dobot_bringup_v4 dobot_bringup_ros2.launch.py # 3. Launch MoveIt control interface (Terminal 2) ros2 launch dobot_moveit dobot_moveit.launch.py ``` ### Optional: Motion Demo After Scenario 5 is running, you can execute a sample motion sequence (EnableRobot + MovJ): ```bash ros2 run dobot_demo demo ``` --- ## Architecture ### Data Flow (Real Robot) ``` Physical Robot (TCP/IP) ├─ 192.168.5.1:29999 ← control commands (dashboard) └─ 192.168.5.1:30004 → 1440-byte binary RealTimeData @100Hz (feedback) dobot_bringup_v4 (C++ node "dobot_bringup_ros2") ├─ CRCommanderRos2: owns two TcpClient instances, recvTask reads feedback ├─ CRRobotRos2: ~124 ROS2 services → parseTool → TCP command string → robot ├─ Publishes: /joint_states_robot, /dobot_msgs_v4/msg/RobotStatus, │ /dobot_msgs_v4/msg/ToolVectorActual └─ ~124 services on: /dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/ dobot_moveit (Python) ├─ joint_states.py: relays /joint_states_robot → /joint_states (MoveIt standard) └─ action_move_server.py: FollowJointTrajectory action → ServoJ service calls ``` ### ROS2 Interface Reference | Topic / Service | Type | Publisher / Server | Description | |-----------------|------|--------------------|-------------| | `/joint_states_robot` | `sensor_msgs/JointState` | `dobot_bringup_v4` | Joint feedback from real robot | | `/joint_states` | `sensor_msgs/JointState` | `dobot_moveit` (relay) | Standard MoveIt joint states | | `/dobot_msgs_v4/msg/RobotStatus` | `dobot_msgs_v4/RobotStatus` | `dobot_bringup_v4` | Robot enable/connect status | | `/dobot_msgs_v4/msg/ToolVectorActual` | `dobot_msgs_v4/ToolVectorActual` | `dobot_bringup_v4` | Tool pose (x,y,z,rx,ry,rz) | | `/{robot}_group_controller/follow_joint_trajectory` | `control_msgs/FollowJointTrajectory` | `dobot_moveit` | MoveIt trajectory execution | | `/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/` | `dobot_msgs_v4/srv/` | `dobot_bringup_v4` | ~124 robot control services | --- ## Project Structure ``` DOBOT_6Axis_ROS2_V4/ ├── dobot_bringup_v4/ # C++ TCP/IP driver, ~124 services + feedback publisher ├── dobot_moveit/ # Python: MoveIt action server + joint state relay ├── dobot_rviz/ # RViz viz + shared URDF/meshes (dependency of all *_moveit) ├── dobot_gazebo/ # Gazebo Sim launch + custom controller_loader ├── dobot_demo/ # Motion demo scripts (MovJ/MovL/DO) ├── dobot_msgs_v4/ # ROS2 msg/srv definitions (2 msg + ~124 srv) ├── servo_action/ # Joint trajectory action client demo ├── cr3_moveit/ # CR3 MoveIt config (URDF/SRDF/YAML/launch) ├── cr5_moveit/ # CR5 MoveIt config ├── cr7_moveit/ # CR7 MoveIt config ├── cr10_moveit/ # CR10 MoveIt config ├── cr10af_moveit/ # CR10AF MoveIt config ├── cr12_moveit/ # CR12 MoveIt config ├── cr16_moveit/ # CR16 MoveIt config ├── cr20_moveit/ # CR20 MoveIt config ├── cr30h_moveit/ # CR30H MoveIt config ├── me6_moveit/ # E6/ME6 MoveIt config ├── nova2_moveit/ # Nova2 MoveIt config ├── nova5_moveit/ # Nova5 MoveIt config ├── cra_description/ # Xacro + meshes for Gazebo simulation ├── misc/ # FK.py, TF.py helpers + TCP/IP protocol PDF ├── docs/ # Installation guides (INSTALL_JAZZY.md) ├── V4新增指令/ # V4 new instruction docs (Chinese) ├── image/ # Documentation images ├── README.md └── README_ZH.md ``` ### Package Dependencies ``` dobot_rviz ──(URDF/meshes)──▶ *_moveit (12 pkgs) ──▶ dobot_moveit cra_description ──(xacro)──▶ dobot_gazebo dobot_msgs_v4 ──(msg/srv)──▶ dobot_bringup_v4, dobot_moveit, dobot_demo, servo_action ``` > **Note:** `dobot_rviz` is not only for visualization. Its `urdf/*.urdf` files are referenced by every `*_moveit` config via `$(find dobot_rviz)/urdf/_robot.urdf`. Removing it breaks all MoveIt packages. --- ## Driver Configuration The real-robot driver reads `dobot_bringup_v4/config/param.json`: ```json { "robot_number": 1, "current_robot": 1, "node_info": [ { "ip_address": "192.168.5.1", "robot_type": "cr5", "trajectory_duration": 0.3, "robot_node_name": "dobot_bringup_ros2" } ] } ``` Environment variables take precedence over `param.json`: - `DOBOT_TYPE` overrides `robot_type` - `IP_address` overrides `ip_address` For multi-robot setups, increase `robot_number` and add entries to `node_info`; `current_robot` selects which one to launch. --- ## Supported Models | Series | Models | |--------|--------| | CR Series | CR3, CR5, CR7, CR10, CR12, CR16, CR20, CR30H | | CRAF Series | CR10AF | | E Series | E6 / ME6 | | Nova Series | Nova2, Nova5 | --- ## Launch Files | Launch File | Package | Description | |-------------|---------|-------------| | `dobot_bringup_ros2.launch.py` | `dobot_bringup_v4` | Launch robot driver (hardware) | | `dobot_rviz.launch.py` | `dobot_rviz` | RViz visualization (robot model only) | | `moveit_demo.launch.py` | `dobot_moveit` | MoveIt virtual demo (fake controller) | | `dobot_moveit.launch.py` | `dobot_moveit` | MoveIt control (real robot, with action_server) | | `moveit_gazebo.launch.py` | `dobot_moveit` | MoveIt side for Gazebo simulation | | `dobot_gazebo.launch.py` | `dobot_gazebo` | Gazebo simulation (robot + ros2_control) | | `sim.launch.py` | `dobot_gazebo` | Gazebo + MoveIt one-click launch | --- ## Notes > ⚠️ **Safety First**: Ensure the robot is in a safe position before operation 1. Ensure computer IP is in the same subnet as robot (192.168.X.X) 2. Ensure ports 29999 and 30004 are not occupied 3. Robot must be in remote TCP/IP control mode --- ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause / Solution | |---------|------------------| | `EnableRobot service not available` | Driver not started. Run Scenario 5 step 2 first, or check `IP_address` is reachable (`ping 192.168.5.1`). | | RViz model jumps up and down | Another machine on the LAN publishes conflicting `/tf`. `dobot_rviz.launch.py` already sets `ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1`; ensure you did not override it. | | MoveIt `GOAL_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED` | Trajectory execution timeout exceeded. Increase `trajectory_execution_timeout` (default 120s) when moving to `dobot_moveit/launch/dobot_joint.launch.py`. | | Gazebo controllers fail to load | `controller_loader.py` polls hardware interfaces; if it times out, the GPU/CPU is too slow. Launch with `gui:=false` to reduce load. | | Build fails on `dobot_msgs_v4` | Build it first: `colcon build --packages-select dobot_msgs_v4`, then build the rest. | | Service call returns `res != 0` | The robot returned an error. Call `ros2 service call /dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/ClearError dobot_msgs_v4/srv/ClearError` and retry. | --- ## Version Information | Information | Content | |-------------|---------| | Current Version | V4.6.5 | | ROS Version | ROS2 Jazzy | | Protocol Version | Dobot TCP/IP V4.6.5 | | Simulation | Gazebo Sim (Harmonic) | --- ## License [MIT License](LICENSE)

<!--This does not replace URDF, and is not an extension of URDF.
    This is a format for representing semantic information about the robot structure.
    A URDF file must exist for this robot as well, where the joints and the links that are referenced are defined
-->
<robot name="cr10_robot">
    <!--GROUPS: Representation of a set of joints and links. This can be useful for specifying DOF to plan for, defining arms, end effectors, etc-->
    <!--LINKS: When a link is specified, the parent joint of that link (if it exists) is automatically included-->
    <!--JOINTS: When a joint is specified, the child link of that joint (which will always exist) is automatically included-->
    <!--CHAINS: When a chain is specified, all the links along the chain (including endpoints) are included in the group. Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->
    <!--SUBGROUPS: Groups can also be formed by referencing to already defined group names-->
    <group name="cr10_group">
        <chain base_link="base_link" tip_link="Link6"/>
    </group>
    <!--GROUP STATES: Purpose: Define a named state for a particular group, in terms of joint values. This is useful to define states like 'folded arms'-->
    <group_state name="home" group="cr10_group">
        <joint name="joint1" value="0"/>
        <joint name="joint2" value="0.3296"/>
        <joint name="joint3" value="-1.3436"/>
        <joint name="joint4" value="-0.3643"/>
        <joint name="joint5" value="1.6134"/>
        <joint name="joint6" value="0"/>
    </group_state>
    <!--DISABLE COLLISIONS: By default it is assumed that any link of the robot could potentially come into collision with any other link in the robot. This tag disables collision checking between a specified pair of links. -->

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import time
import os
from launch_ros.actions import Node
def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr10_robot", package_name="cr10_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[

    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr12_robot", package_name="cr12_moveit").to_moveit_configs() 

    ld = LaunchDescription()

    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld


def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("capabilities", default_value=""))
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("disable_capabilities", default_value=""))

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]
    move_group_params.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": ":0"},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]
    rviz_parameters.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group

    # 启动rviz

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[
            moveit_config.robot_description,
            {
                "publish_frequency": LaunchConfiguration("publish_frequency"),
            },
        ],
    )
    ld.add_action(rsp_node)

    return ld

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )

    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(

        )
    )

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

<!--This does not replace URDF, and is not an extension of URDF.
    This is a format for representing semantic information about the robot structure.
    A URDF file must exist for this robot as well, where the joints and the links that are referenced are defined
-->
<robot name="cr30h_robot">
    <!--GROUPS: Representation of a set of joints and links. This can be useful for specifying DOF to plan for, defining arms, end effectors, etc-->
    <!--LINKS: When a link is specified, the parent joint of that link (if it exists) is automatically included-->
    <!--JOINTS: When a joint is specified, the child link of that joint (which will always exist) is automatically included-->
    <!--CHAINS: When a chain is specified, all the links along the chain (including endpoints) are included in the group. Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->
    <!--SUBGROUPS: Groups can also be formed by referencing to already defined group names-->
    <group name="cr30h_group">
        <chain base_link="base_link" tip_link="Link6"/>
    </group>
    <!--GROUP STATES: Purpose: Define a named state for a particular group, in terms of joint values. This is useful to define states like 'folded arms'-->
    <group_state name="home" group="cr30h_group">
        <joint name="joint1" value="0"/>
        <joint name="joint2" value="0.6592"/>
        <joint name="joint3" value="1.6185"/>
        <joint name="joint4" value="-0.1041"/>
        <joint name="joint5" value="1.6307"/>
        <joint name="joint6" value="0"/>
    </group_state>
    <!--DISABLE COLLISIONS: By default it is assumed that any link of the robot could potentially come into collision with any other link in the robot. This tag disables collision checking between a specified pair of links. -->
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="Link2" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="Link4" reason="Never"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="base_link" reason="Adjacent"/>

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import time
import os
from launch_ros.actions import Node
def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr30h_robot", package_name="cr30h_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[
            moveit_config.robot_description,
            {
                "publish_frequency": LaunchConfiguration("publish_frequency"),
            },
        ],
    )
    ld.add_action(rsp_node)

    return ld

def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["capabilities"],
        )
    )
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "disable_capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["disable_capabilities"],
        )
    )

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": os.environ["DISPLAY"]},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue


def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr30h_robot", package_name="cr30h_moveit").to_moveit_configs() 

    ld = LaunchDescription()

    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld


def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("capabilities", default_value=""))
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("disable_capabilities", default_value=""))

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]
    move_group_params.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": ":0"},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]
    rviz_parameters.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

    <!--LINKS: When a link is specified, the parent joint of that link (if it exists) is automatically included-->
    <!--JOINTS: When a joint is specified, the child link of that joint (which will always exist) is automatically included-->
    <!--CHAINS: When a chain is specified, all the links along the chain (including endpoints) are included in the group. Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->
    <!--SUBGROUPS: Groups can also be formed by referencing to already defined group names-->
    <group name="cr3_group">

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import time
import os
from launch_ros.actions import Node
def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr3_robot", package_name="cr3_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[
            moveit_config.robot_description,
            {
                "publish_frequency": LaunchConfiguration("publish_frequency"),
            },
        ],
    )
    ld.add_action(rsp_node)

    return ld

def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["capabilities"],
        )
    )
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "disable_capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["disable_capabilities"],
        )
    )

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": os.environ["DISPLAY"]},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

    This is a format for representing semantic information about the robot structure.
    A URDF file must exist for this robot as well, where the joints and the links that are referenced are defined
-->
<robot name="cr5_robot">
    <!--GROUPS: Representation of a set of joints and links. This can be useful for specifying DOF to plan for, defining arms, end effectors, etc-->
    <!--LINKS: When a link is specified, the parent joint of that link (if it exists) is automatically included-->
    <!--JOINTS: When a joint is specified, the child link of that joint (which will always exist) is automatically included-->
    <!--CHAINS: When a chain is specified, all the links along the chain (including endpoints) are included in the group. Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->
    <!--SUBGROUPS: Groups can also be formed by referencing to already defined group names-->
    <group name="cr5_group">
        <chain base_link="base_link" tip_link="Link6"/>
    </group>
    <!--GROUP STATES: Purpose: Define a named state for a particular group, in terms of joint values. This is useful to define states like 'folded arms'-->

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import time
import os
from launch_ros.actions import Node
def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr5_robot", package_name="cr5_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[
            moveit_config.robot_description,
            {
                "publish_frequency": LaunchConfiguration("publish_frequency"),
            },
        ],
    )
    ld.add_action(rsp_node)

    return ld

def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["capabilities"],
        )
    )
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "disable_capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["disable_capabilities"],
        )
    )

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": os.environ["DISPLAY"]},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

import os
import xacro
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue


def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr5_robot", package_name="cr5_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    # Override robot_description with the Gazebo-compatible URDF (uses
    # gz_ros2_control/GazeboSimSystem instead of mock_components/GenericSystem)
    # so that gz_ros2_control can load the correct hardware interface.
    cra_description_path = get_package_share_directory('cra_description')
    xacro_file = os.path.join(cra_description_path, 'urdf', 'cr5_robot.xacro')
    doc = xacro.parse(open(xacro_file))
    xacro.process_doc(doc)
    moveit_config.robot_description = {'robot_description': doc.toxml()}

    ld = LaunchDescription()

    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld


def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("capabilities", default_value=""))
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("disable_capabilities", default_value=""))

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]
    move_group_params.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": ":0"},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]
    rviz_parameters.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

    This is a format for representing semantic information about the robot structure.
    A URDF file must exist for this robot as well, where the joints and the links that are referenced are defined
-->
<robot name="cr7_robot">
    <!--GROUPS: Representation of a set of joints and links. This can be useful for specifying DOF to plan for, defining arms, end effectors, etc-->
    <!--LINKS: When a link is specified, the parent joint of that link (if it exists) is automatically included-->
    <!--JOINTS: When a joint is specified, the child link of that joint (which will always exist) is automatically included-->
    <!--CHAINS: When a chain is specified, all the links along the chain (including endpoints) are included in the group. Additionally, all the joints that are parents to included links are also included. This means that joints along the chain and the parent joint of the base link are included in the group-->
    <!--SUBGROUPS: Groups can also be formed by referencing to already defined group names-->
    <group name="cr7_group">
        <chain base_link="base_link" tip_link="Link6"/>
    </group>
    <!--GROUP STATES: Purpose: Define a named state for a particular group, in terms of joint values. This is useful to define states like 'folded arms'-->
    <group_state name="home" group="cr7_group">
        <joint name="joint1" value="0"/>
        <joint name="joint2" value="0.5898"/>
        <joint name="joint3" value="-1.4952"/>
        <joint name="joint4" value="-0.5204"/>
        <joint name="joint5" value="1.5613"/>
        <joint name="joint6" value="0"/>
    </group_state>
    <!--DISABLE COLLISIONS: By default it is assumed that any link of the robot could potentially come into collision with any other link in the robot. This tag disables collision checking between a specified pair of links. -->
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="Link2" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="Link4" reason="Never"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link1" link2="base_link" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link2" link2="Link3" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link2" link2="base_link" reason="Never"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link3" link2="Link4" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link4" link2="Link5" reason="Adjacent"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link4" link2="Link6" reason="Never"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link4" link2="base_link" reason="Never"/>
    <disable_collisions link1="Link5" link2="Link6" reason="Adjacent"/>
</robot>

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue
import time
import os
from launch_ros.actions import Node
def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr7_robot", package_name="cr7_moveit").to_moveit_configs()

    ld = LaunchDescription()
    my_generate_rsp_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld
def my_generate_rsp_launch(ld,moveit_config):
    """Launch file for robot state publisher (rsp)"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("publish_frequency", default_value="15.0"))

    # Given the published joint states, publish tf for the robot links and the robot description
    rsp_node = Node(
        package="robot_state_publisher",
        executable="robot_state_publisher",
        respawn=True,
        output="screen",
        parameters=[
            moveit_config.robot_description,
            {
                "publish_frequency": LaunchConfiguration("publish_frequency"),
            },
        ],
    )
    ld.add_action(rsp_node)

    return ld

def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["capabilities"],
        )
    )
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "disable_capabilities",
            default_value=moveit_config.move_group_capabilities["disable_capabilities"],
        )
    )

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": os.environ["DISPLAY"]},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

from moveit_configs_utils import MoveItConfigsBuilder
from moveit_configs_utils.launches import generate_moveit_rviz_launch

from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch.actions import (
    DeclareLaunchArgument,
    IncludeLaunchDescription,
)
from moveit_configs_utils.launch_utils import (
    add_debuggable_node,
    DeclareBooleanLaunchArg,
)
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration
from launch_ros.parameter_descriptions import ParameterValue


def generate_launch_description():
    moveit_config = MoveItConfigsBuilder("cr7_robot", package_name="cr7_moveit").to_moveit_configs() 

    ld = LaunchDescription()

    # 启动move_group
    my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config)
    # 启动rviz
    my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config)

    return ld


def my_generate_move_group_launch(ld, moveit_config):

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("allow_trajectory_execution", default_value=True)
    )
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("publish_monitored_planning_scene", default_value=True)
    )
    # load non-default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("capabilities", default_value=""))
    # inhibit these default MoveGroup capabilities (space separated)
    ld.add_action(DeclareLaunchArgument("disable_capabilities", default_value=""))

    # do not copy dynamics information from /joint_states to internal robot monitoring
    # default to false, because almost nothing in move_group relies on this information
    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("monitor_dynamics", default_value=False))

    should_publish = LaunchConfiguration("publish_monitored_planning_scene")

    move_group_configuration = {
        "publish_robot_description_semantic": True,
        "allow_trajectory_execution": LaunchConfiguration("allow_trajectory_execution"),
        # Note: Wrapping the following values is necessary so that the parameter value can be the empty string
        "capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        "disable_capabilities": ParameterValue(
            LaunchConfiguration("disable_capabilities"), value_type=str
        ),
        # Publish the planning scene of the physical robot so that rviz plugin can know actual robot
        "publish_planning_scene": should_publish,
        "publish_geometry_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_state_updates": should_publish,
        "publish_transforms_updates": should_publish,
        "monitor_dynamics": False,
    }

    move_group_params = [
        moveit_config.to_dict(),
        move_group_configuration,
    ]
    move_group_params.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="moveit_ros_move_group",
        executable="move_group",
        commands_file=str(moveit_config.package_path / "launch" / "gdb_settings.gdb"),
        output="screen",
        parameters=move_group_params,
        extra_debug_args=["--debug"],
        # Set the display variable, in case OpenGL code is used internally
        additional_env={"DISPLAY": ":0"},
    )
    return ld

def my_generate_moveit_rviz_launch(ld, moveit_config):
    """Launch file for rviz"""

    ld.add_action(DeclareBooleanLaunchArg("debug", default_value=False))
    ld.add_action(
        DeclareLaunchArgument(
            "rviz_config",
            default_value=str(moveit_config.package_path / "config/moveit.rviz"),
        )
    )

    rviz_parameters = [
        moveit_config.planning_pipelines,
        moveit_config.robot_description_kinematics,
    ]
    rviz_parameters.append({"use_sim_time": True})

    add_debuggable_node(
        ld,
        package="rviz2",
        executable="rviz2",
        output="log",
        respawn=False,
        arguments=["-d", LaunchConfiguration("rviz_config")],
        parameters=rviz_parameters,
    )

    return ld

/*!

@def NLOHMANN_JSON_SERIALIZE_ENUM

*/
#define NLOHMANN_JSON_SERIALIZE_ENUM(ENUM_TYPE, ...)                                            \
    template<typename BasicJsonType>                                                            \
    inline void to_json(BasicJsonType& j, const ENUM_TYPE& e)                                   \
    {                                                                                           \
        static_assert(std::is_enum<ENUM_TYPE>::value, #ENUM_TYPE " must be an enum!");          \
        static const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType> m[] = __VA_ARGS__;                     \
        auto it = std::find_if(std::begin(m), std::end(m),                                      \
                               [e](const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType>& ej_pair) -> bool  \
        {                                                                                       \
            return ej_pair.first == e;                                                          \
        });                                                                                     \
        j = ((it != std::end(m)) ? it : std::begin(m))->second;                                 \
    }                                                                                           \
    template<typename BasicJsonType>                                                            \
    inline void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ENUM_TYPE& e)                                 \
    {                                                                                           \
        static_assert(std::is_enum<ENUM_TYPE>::value, #ENUM_TYPE " must be an enum!");          \
        static const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType> m[] = __VA_ARGS__;                     \
        auto it = std::find_if(std::begin(m), std::end(m),                                      \
                               [&j](const std::pair<ENUM_TYPE, BasicJsonType>& ej_pair) -> bool \
        {                                                                                       \
            return ej_pair.second == j;                                                         \
        });                                                                                     \
        e = ((it != std::end(m)) ? it : std::begin(m))->first;                                  \
    }

// inspired from https://stackoverflow.com/a/26745591
// allows to call any std function as if (e.g. with begin):
// using std::begin; begin(x);
//
// it allows using the detected idiom to retrieve the return type
// of such an expression
#define NLOHMANN_CAN_CALL_STD_FUNC_IMPL(std_name)                                 \
    namespace detail {                                                            \
    using std::std_name;                                                          \
    \
    template<typename... T>                                                       \
    using result_of_##std_name = decltype(std_name(std::declval<T>()...));        \
    }                                                                             \
    \
    namespace detail2 {                                                           \
    struct std_name##_tag                                                         \
    {                                                                             \
    };                                                                            \
    \
    template<typename... T>                                                       \
    std_name##_tag std_name(T&&...);                                              \
    \
    template<typename... T>                                                       \
    using result_of_##std_name = decltype(std_name(std::declval<T>()...));        \
    \
    template<typename... T>                                                       \
    struct would_call_std_##std_name                                              \
    {                                                                             \
        static constexpr auto const value = ::nlohmann::detail::                  \
                                            is_detected_exact<std_name##_tag, result_of_##std_name, T...>::value; \
    };                                                                            \
    } /* namespace detail2 */ \
    \
    template<typename... T>                                                       \
    struct would_call_std_##std_name : detail2::would_call_std_##std_name<T...>   \
    {                                                                             \
    }

import launch_ros.actions
import json
import os

cur_path = os.path.split(os.path.realpath(__file__))[0] + '/'
cur_config_path = cur_path + '../config'
cur_json_path = os.path.join(cur_config_path, 'param.json')

# 读取 JSON 文件
with open(cur_json_path, 'r') as file:
    json_data = json.load(file)

robot_number = json_data["robot_number"]
current_robot = json_data['current_robot']
node_info = json_data["node_info"]


# ip_address = json_data["node_info"][current_robot -
#                                     1]["ip_address"]    # robot IP
# robot_type = json_data["node_info"][current_robot -
#                                     1]["robot_type"]  # robot type
trajectory_duration = json_data["node_info"][current_robot -
                                             1]["trajectory_duration"]
robot_node_name = json_data["node_info"][current_robot -
                                         1]["robot_node_name"]
ip_address = os.getenv("IP_address") or json_data["node_info"][current_robot - 1]["ip_address"]

robot_type = os.getenv("DOBOT_TYPE") or json_data["node_info"][current_robot - 1]["robot_type"]


dobot_ros2_params = [
    {"robot_ip_address": ip_address},
    {"robot_type": robot_type},
    {"trajectory_duration": trajectory_duration},
    {"robot_node_name": robot_node_name},
    {"robot_number": robot_number},
]


def generate_launch_description():

    return LaunchDescription([
        SetEnvironmentVariable('ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE', 'LOCALHOST'),
        launch_ros.actions.Node(
            package='dobot_bringup_v4',
            executable='dobot_bringup_v4_node',
            name=robot_node_name,
            output='screen',
            parameters=dobot_ros2_params
            # respawn=True
        ),
    ])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from dobot_msgs_v4.srv import EnableRobot, MovJ, MovL, SpeedFactor, DO

class DobotDemo(Node):
    def __init__(self, name):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.EnableRobot_l = self.create_client(EnableRobot, '/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/EnableRobot')
        self.MovJ_l        = self.create_client(MovJ,        '/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/MovJ')
        self.SpeedFactor_l = self.create_client(SpeedFactor, '/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/SpeedFactor')
        self.MovL_l        = self.create_client(MovL,        '/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/MovL')
        self.DO_l          = self.create_client(DO,          '/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/DO')

        # 等待所有必需的服务上线
        for cli, label in [(self.EnableRobot_l, 'EnableRobot'), (self.MovJ_l, 'MovJ')]:
            while not cli.wait_for_service(timeout_sec=1.0):
                self.get_logger().info(f'{label} service not available, waiting...')
        self.get_logger().info('All services available, ready.')

    def initialization(self):
        """使能机器人并设置速度比例"""
        # 使能
        response = self.EnableRobot_l.call_async(EnableRobot.Request())
        rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(self, response)
        result = response.result()
        if result is not None and result.res == 0:
            self.get_logger().info('EnableRobot OK')
        else:
            self.get_logger().error(f'EnableRobot failed: {result}')

        # 速度设为 10%
        spe = SpeedFactor.Request()
        spe.ratio = 10
        response = self.SpeedFactor_l.call_async(spe)
        rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(self, response)
        result = response.result()
        if result is not None and result.res == 0:
            self.get_logger().info(f'SpeedFactor set to {spe.ratio}%')
        else:
            self.get_logger().error(f'SpeedFactor failed: {result}')

    def move(self, Move, X_j1, Y_j2, Z_j3, RX_j4, RY_j5, RZ_j6):
        """执行运动指令 (MovJ 或 MovL)"""
        if Move == "MovJ":
            req = MovJ.Request()
            req.mode = True
            req.a = float(X_j1)
            req.b = float(Y_j2)
            req.c = float(Z_j3)
            req.d = float(RX_j4)
            req.e = float(RY_j5)
            req.f = float(RZ_j6)
            response = self.MovJ_l.call_async(req)
            rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(self, response)
            result = response.result()
            if result is not None and result.res == 0:
                self.get_logger().info(f'MovJ OK: [{X_j1}, {Y_j2}, {Z_j3}, {RX_j4}, {RY_j5}, {RZ_j6}]')
            else:
                self.get_logger().error(f'MovJ failed: {result}')
        elif Move == "MovL":
            req = MovL.Request()
            req.mode = True
            req.a = float(X_j1)
            req.b = float(Y_j2)
            req.c = float(Z_j3)
            req.d = float(RX_j4)
            req.e = float(RY_j5)
            req.f = float(RZ_j6)
            response = self.MovL_l.call_async(req)
            rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(self, response)
            result = response.result()
            if result is not None and result.res == 0:
                self.get_logger().info(f'MovL OK: [{X_j1}, {Y_j2}, {Z_j3}, {RX_j4}, {RY_j5}, {RZ_j6}]')
            else:
                self.get_logger().error(f'MovL failed: {result}')
        else:
            self.get_logger().warning(f"Unknown move type: {Move}")

    def set_do(self, index, status, time_ms=0):
        """控制数字输出 (夹爪/气泵)
        index:   IO 索引
        status:  0=OFF, 1=ON
        time_ms: 脉冲时间(ms), 0=永久保持
        """
        req = DO.Request()
        req.index = int(index)
        req.status = int(status)
        req.time = int(time_ms)
        response = self.DO_l.call_async(req)
        rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(self, response)
        result = response.result()
        if result is not None and result.res == 0:
            self.get_logger().info(f'DO {index} = {status} (time={time_ms}ms)')
        else:
            self.get_logger().error(f'DO {index} failed: {result}')


def main(args=None):
    rclpy.init(args=args)
    node = DobotDemo("dobot_demo")

    # 初始化：使能机器人 + 设置速度
    node.initialization()

    # 示例运动序列
    node.move("MovJ", 50, -8, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    node.move("MovJ",  0, -8, 0, 0, 0, 0)

    node.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Load and activate controllers for Gazebo simulation.

Works around a gz_ros2_control bug where load_controller and
configure_controller service calls return ok=false non-deterministically
even when the operation actually succeeds. Instead of trusting the ok field,
this script checks the actual controller state via list_controllers.

Controllers are loaded and configured in PARALLEL to minimize startup time.

Usage: controller_loader.py <robot_type>
Example: controller_loader.py cr5
"""
import sys
import time
import rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from controller_manager_msgs.srv import (
    ListControllers, ListHardwareInterfaces,
    LoadController, ConfigureController, SwitchController,
)

MAX_RETRIES = 10
POLL_INTERVAL = 0.2


def list_all_controllers(node, list_cli, timeout=5.0, retries=3):
    """Return dict {name: state} of all controllers, or {} on failure.

    Retries the service call to handle transient failures where the
    response is empty or the call times out (often caused by pending
    responses from previous load/configure requests still in the queue).
    """
    for i in range(retries):
        req = ListControllers.Request()
        future = list_cli.call_async(req)
        rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(node, future, timeout_sec=timeout)
        if future.done() and future.result() is not None:
            result = {c.name: c.state for c in future.result().controller}
            if result:  # non-empty response
                return result
        # Empty response or timeout; retry after short pause
        if i < retries - 1:
            time.sleep(0.1)
    return {}


def call_service_async(node, cli, request):
    """Call a service asynchronously, return the future."""
    return cli.call_async(request)


def main():
    rclpy.init(args=sys.argv)
    robot_type = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'cr5'

    controllers = [
        f'{robot_type}_group_controller',
        'joint_state_broadcaster',
    ]

    node = Node('controller_loader')
    # NOTE: Do NOT use sim_time here. With use_sim_time=true, service call
    # futures don't complete reliably (controller_manager uses sim_time but
    # the rclpy wait mechanism needs system time). System time works fine.
    logger = node.get_logger()

    # Wait for controller_manager
    list_cli = node.create_client(ListControllers, '/controller_manager/list_controllers')
    load_cli = node.create_client(LoadController, '/controller_manager/load_controller')
    cfg_cli = node.create_client(ConfigureController, '/controller_manager/configure_controller')
    sw_cli = node.create_client(SwitchController, '/controller_manager/switch_controller')
    hw_cli = node.create_client(ListHardwareInterfaces, '/controller_manager/list_hardware_interfaces')

    logger.info('Waiting for controller_manager...')
    for i in range(60):
        if list_cli.wait_for_service(timeout_sec=2.0):
            logger.info('Controller manager ready')
            break
    else:
        logger.fatal('Timeout waiting for controller_manager')
        sys.exit(1)

    # Wait for Gazebo hardware interfaces to be available before loading
    # controllers. This replaces a fixed 8s sleep: we poll list_hardware_interfaces
    # until the command interfaces (joint1/position, etc.) appear.
    logger.info('Waiting for hardware interfaces...')
    start = time.time()
    for attempt in range(100):
        req = ListHardwareInterfaces.Request()
        future = hw_cli.call_async(req)
        rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(node, future, timeout_sec=2.0)
        if future.done() and future.result() is not None:
            cmd_ifaces = [i.name for i in future.result().command_interfaces]
            if any('position' in n for n in cmd_ifaces):
                logger.info(f'  Hardware ready ({len(cmd_ifaces)} cmd interfaces, '
                            f'{time.time()-start:.1f}s)')
                break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    else:
        logger.fatal('Timeout waiting for hardware interfaces')
        sys.exit(1)

    # --- Phase 1: Parallel LOAD all controllers ---
    # Send all load requests at once, then poll until all appear in list_controllers.
    states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
    to_load = [n for n in controllers if n not in states or states[n] == 'unconfigured']
    if to_load:
        logger.info(f'Loading (parallel): {to_load}')
        # Send all load requests simultaneously
        for name in to_load:
            req = LoadController.Request()
            req.name = name
            call_service_async(node, load_cli, req)
        # Poll until all loaded controllers appear (state will be 'unconfigured')
        for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
            rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.1)
            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL)
            states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
            if all(n in states for n in to_load):
                logger.info(f'  All loaded: {[(n, states[n]) for n in to_load]}')
                break
            # Resend load requests that haven't appeared yet
            missing = [n for n in to_load if n not in states]
            for name in missing:
                req = LoadController.Request()
                req.name = name
                call_service_async(node, load_cli, req)
        else:
            logger.fatal(f'  Failed to load after {MAX_RETRIES} attempts: {states}')
            sys.exit(1)

    # --- Phase 2: Parallel CONFIGURE all unconfigured controllers ---
    states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
    to_configure = [n for n in controllers if states.get(n) == 'unconfigured']
    if to_configure:
        logger.info(f'Configuring (parallel): {to_configure}')
        # Send all configure requests simultaneously
        for name in to_configure:
            req = ConfigureController.Request()
            req.name = name
            call_service_async(node, cfg_cli, req)
        # Poll until all reach inactive/active
        for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
            rclpy.spin_once(node, timeout_sec=0.1)
            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL)
            states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
            if all(states.get(n) in ('inactive', 'active') for n in to_configure):
                logger.info(f'  All configured: {[(n, states[n]) for n in to_configure]}')
                break
            # Resend configure requests for stuck controllers
            stuck = [n for n in to_configure if states.get(n) == 'unconfigured']
            for name in stuck:
                req = ConfigureController.Request()
                req.name = name
                call_service_async(node, cfg_cli, req)
        else:
            logger.fatal(f'  Failed to configure after {MAX_RETRIES} attempts: {states}')
            sys.exit(1)

    # --- Phase 3: ACTIVATE all inactive controllers at once ---
    states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
    to_activate = [n for n in controllers if states.get(n) == 'inactive']
    if to_activate:
        logger.info(f'Activating: {to_activate}')
        req = SwitchController.Request()
        req.activate_controllers = to_activate
        req.strictness = SwitchController.Request.BEST_EFFORT
        for attempt in range(MAX_RETRIES):
            sw_future = sw_cli.call_async(req)
            rclpy.spin_until_future_complete(node, sw_future, timeout_sec=5.0)
            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL)
            states = list_all_controllers(node, list_cli)
            if all(states.get(n) == 'active' for n in to_activate):
                logger.info(f'  All controllers active')
                break
        else:
            logger.fatal(f'  Failed to activate after {MAX_RETRIES} attempts: {states}')
            sys.exit(1)

    # Phase 3 already verified all controllers are active.
    # (Final verification removed: list_controllers can transiently return
    # empty right after a switch_controller call, causing false negatives.)

    logger.info('All controllers loaded and activated successfully!')
    node.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import os
from ament_index_python.packages import get_package_share_directory
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch_ros.actions import Node
from launch.actions import (DeclareLaunchArgument, IncludeLaunchDescription, ExecuteProcess,
                            RegisterEventHandler, SetEnvironmentVariable)
from launch.event_handlers import OnProcessExit
from launch.launch_description_sources import PythonLaunchDescriptionSource
from launch.substitutions import LaunchConfiguration, PythonExpression
import xacro


def generate_launch_description():
    name = os.getenv("DOBOT_TYPE", "cr5")
    robot_name_in_model = f'{name}_robot'
    package_name = 'cra_description'
    urdf_name = f"{name}_robot.xacro"

    # Gazebo GUI is enabled by default. On machines without a GPU the GUI may fall
    # back to software rendering and consume high CPU; in that case launch with
    # gui:=false to run server-only (RViz still provides visualization).
    gui_arg = DeclareLaunchArgument('gui', default_value='true')
    gz_args = PythonExpression(
        ["'-r empty.sdf' if '", LaunchConfiguration('gui'), "' == 'true' else '-s -r empty.sdf'"]
    )

    gazebo = IncludeLaunchDescription(
        PythonLaunchDescriptionSource([os.path.join(
            get_package_share_directory('ros_gz_sim'), 'launch'), '/gz_sim.launch.py']),
        launch_arguments={'gz_args': gz_args}.items(),
    )

    cra_description_path = os.path.join(
        get_package_share_directory(package_name))

    xacro_file = os.path.join(cra_description_path,
                              'urdf',
                              urdf_name)
    doc = xacro.parse(open(xacro_file))
    xacro.process_doc(doc)
    robot_description_config = doc.toxml()
    robot_description = {'robot_description': robot_description_config, 'use_sim_time': True}

    node_robot_state_publisher = Node(
        package='robot_state_publisher',
        executable='robot_state_publisher',
        output='screen',
        parameters=[robot_description]
    )

    spawn_entity = Node(package='ros_gz_sim', executable='create',
                        arguments=['-topic', 'robot_description',
                                   '-name', robot_name_in_model],
                        output='screen')

    clock_bridge = Node(package='ros_gz_bridge', executable='parameter_bridge',
                        arguments=['/clock@rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock[gz.msgs.Clock'],
                        output='screen')

    # Use our custom controller_loader instead of the ros2_control spawner.
    # The spawner aborts on the first ok=false response, but gz_ros2_control
    # non-deterministically returns ok=false even when operations succeed.
    # controller_loader.py checks actual controller state via list_controllers
    # instead of trusting the ok field. It also waits for hardware interfaces
    # to be available before loading controllers, so no fixed delay is needed.
    spawn_controllers = ExecuteProcess(
        cmd=['ros2', 'run', 'dobot_gazebo', 'controller_loader.py', name],
        output='screen',
    )

    close_evt = RegisterEventHandler(
            event_handler=OnProcessExit(
                target_action=spawn_entity,
                on_exit=[spawn_controllers],
            )
    )

    return LaunchDescription([
      SetEnvironmentVariable('ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE', 'LOCALHOST'),
      gui_arg,
      close_evt,
      gazebo,
      clock_bridge,
      node_robot_state_publisher,
      spawn_entity
    ])
